argv: Use two explore subagents concurrently (two task calls in one message). Ask one to trace engine selection in terminal/strata_control/shape_engine.py and one to trace manifest validation in terminal/strata_control/engine_component.py. Wait for both and report one finding per file.
text:
Both subagents completed. Findings:

- **`terminal/strata_control/shape_engine.py`** — Engine selection is delegated to the signed feed: `choose()` (lines 266–272) filters `feed.shape_engines` by shape and calls `feed.select_engine(mine, hardware)`; `update_one()` and `ensure()` drive it, with refusal in `_test_start()`/`check_geometry()` and shape validation in `valid()`/`root()`.
- **`terminal/strata_control/engine_component.py`** — Manifest validation is done by `read_manifest()` (lines 279–349): JSON parse, schema version, id/name/kind agreement, required strings, `backend` in `BACKEND_MATRIX`, file-entry checks (relative paths, 64-hex sha256, bytes), entrypoint membership and uniqueness, archs/min_driver/signature shape. File integrity is checked in `verify()` (lines 447–478) and signature in `verify_signature()` (lines 386–413).
